column1: # Editorial rules, so this stays a CURATION and not a package dump:
#   1. Wayland-native, or at least sane under XWayland. SynapseOS has no X11
#   2. One recommendation per job. A list with four PDF readers is a search
#      result, not a suggestion. In Games the "job" is the GENRE — nobody wants
#      one game, but they do not want three Lemmings clones either. Gaming is
#      how you RUN games (launchers, Wine, overlays); Games are the games.
#   3. Prefer `repo` over `aur` over `flatpak`. Repo packages are the only ones
#   4. Category order below is the display order. It is editorial: the things a
#      fresh install most often lacks come first.
